messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.05-1
parts:
A new version of R/qtl (1.05-1) has been released at its web site
(http://www.rqtl.org).

A major bug was found regarding permutations with scanone and scantwo
in the case of covariates. Such covariates should be permuted along
with the phenotypes, but hadn't been.

See http://www.rqtl.org/STATUS.txt for a complete list of changes.

The package is on its way to CRAN (http://cran.r-project.org); the
Windows version of the package is not yet posted but will be soon.

As always, I'd appreciate hearing any suggestions or comments or
complaints.

Karl Broman
kbr...@jhsph.edu
